# procedure type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:procedureType`](gmeow-procedureType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/procedureType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

The kind(s) of a procedure, drawn from the open [`gmeow:ProcedureType`](../classes/gmeow-ProcedureType.md) value vocabulary. Non-functional: a procedure may serve several purposes (a research plan that is also a data pipeline), and competing standpoint-indexed type claims coexist rather than contradict.
